QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Unsettling Future 2
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bStands With Bulls#k, a resident in #bTwilight Perion#k.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Stands with Bulls, the people of Perion resisted the Black Mage and lost. Then they were put to hard labor. Perion's sage, Dances with Balrog, lost his life...

#e#bTalk to the son of Dances with Balrog.
QuestInfo.2: You met Wrestles the Wolves, a resident in Twilight Perion.

0.0: Sorry about that, the tuberculosis makes it hard to speak. Now then, the #bwarriors of Perion#k are gone. They fought bravely until the end, even after the #rBlack Mage#k took over Maple World, but they are no more.
0.1: All of them have been enslaved or cast out. The price for their resistance was hard labor for all of Perion's citizens. You'll find most of them working on that ugly #rBlack Mage Statue#k, but others have found a #brefuge#k and still try to pass on the history of Perion.
0.2: Even the great #bDances with Balrog#k could not survive this treatment... He fell as a warrior, though #bhis son#k lives on. He's young still, but has taken his place in the Warriors' Sanctuary.

no.0: Did you still have something else to ask me?

0.msg: That's interesting. You don't look old enough to remember Dances with Balrog...

1.msg: #b(I should go to Warriors' Sanctuary and meet the son of Dances with Balrog.)#k

1.0: I have nothing to say to the Black Mage's lackeys.

yes.0: Forgive my rudeness, traveler. My father's name stirs dark memories in me. What did you need?

0.msg: #b(I should go to Warriors' Sanctuary and meet the son of Dances with Balrog.)#k
